title: Half Double Crochet
description: A versatile stitch that works up faster than single crochet but stays easy to read.

content.summary: Half double crochet sits between single and double crochet in height and speed.
content.whyItMatters: It is ideal for scarves, simple garments, and soft, flexible fabric.
steps: Yarn over before inserting the hook.
Insert the hook into the next stitch and pull up a loop.
Yarn over and pull through all three loops on the hook.
content.practice: Work 2 rows of 12 half double crochet stitches.
commonMistakes: Pulling through two loops instead of all three.
